subject: Interpreting epistatic LOD scores from the 2D scan

messages.author: f28bbf1544c274f8
messages.subject: Interpreting epistatic LOD scores from the 2D scan
parts:
Dear Karl, 

I need your help in understanding the followings from a 2D scan-

1. To determine significant threshold I performed 100 permutations in 10-cm increments using HK method. I have 250 F2  individuals. I have also run permutation for males (117) and females (133) separately. Here are the values. How robust is my threshold value? Is this acceptable?

(i) Both male and female
> summary(operm2.bulb)
bulb (100 permutations)
            full     fv1     int     add    av1     one
5%       11.6  9.42  8.18   6.67   3.44    3.82
10%     11.0  8.96  7.85   6.36   3.34    3.43
 
(ii) Male
> summary(operm2.male.bulb)
 bulb (100 permutations)
            full     fv1    int      add    av1    one
5%       11.5   9.31 8.42   6.83   3.44   3.87
10%     11.0   9.16 8.16   6.66   3.28   3.52

(ii) Female
 > summary(operm2.female.bulb)
bulb (100 permutations)
            full      fv1    int     add   av1   one
5%       12.0   9.56  8.51  7.03  3.90  3.80
10%     11.4   9.09  8.01  6.78  3.51  3.72
> 

2.  At 5% level, I am getting some negative interaction LOD (lod.int) value, marked as "[]". How should I interpret this?

> summary(out2.bulb, thresholds=c(11.6,9.42,8.18,6.67,3.42))
           pos1f  pos2f  lod.full   lod.fv1   lod.int     pos1a   pos2a    lod.add  lod.av1
c5 :c9     52    15      12.8      8.33      3.97        37        14         8.83      4.36
c5 :c19    56    21      11.6     7.56      4.12        35        59         7.52      3.45
c9 :c14     0     0       0.0      [-4.47]     [-8.03]     75        24        8.03      3.56
c9 :c19    74    64      11.6     7.13      2.64        14        65         8.96      4.49
c14:c19     0     0       0.0     [-4.01]     -8.06       14        61         8.06      4.05
> 
3. For some cases there is no epistatic QTLs at 5% significance level . But, using "max(out.x)" command if I pick the epistatic loci,  then getting a high interactive lod (lod.int) for the maximum epistatic QTL pairs  and these interacting loci is catching up a good amount variability. My question is, this lod value does not show up in the specific significant threshold levels, yet, how they can explain so much variability (e.g. >30% of the total variation)?


Best regrads, 
Mehedi
